title: HarP-BO: Bayesian optimization of high-harmonic generation with HarP
description:
HarP-BO is a physics-informed Bayesian optimization framework for high-order harmonic generation in gases, built on BoTorch and GPyTorch and coupled to the HarP propagation code. It optimizes the conversion efficiency over pressure, medium length, laser intensity and pulse duration in nonlinearly transformed coordinates, and reconstructs the conversion-efficiency landscape with a Gaussian-process surrogate.

This version contains the code, the run data and the analysis scripts behind the paper "Physics-informed Bayesian optimization of high-harmonic generation in gases".
